faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions by Parents
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions by Parents
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about tutor vetting, safety, fees, and trial sessions.
faq.a1: Every tutor must submit their National ID (NID), student ID or university degree certificate, and contact details. Our team manually verifies documents before profile activation.
faq.q2: How quickly can I find a tutor for my child?
faq.a2: You can browse and message verified tutors directly. Most tutors respond within 15 to 30 minutes, allowing you to finalize schedules quickly.
faq.q3: Can I request home tutoring in my specific neighborhood?
faq.a3: Yes! You can filter tutors specifically for Home Tutoring in your exact area across Dhaka, Chattogram, and all 64 districts.
faq.a4: Yes, thousands of verified tutors provide online tuition with digital whiteboards, screen sharing, and personalized study schedules.
faq.q5: What are the platform fees for parents?
faq.a5: Finding and contacting tutors is 100% free for parents. There are zero agency commissions or hidden charges.
faq.q6: Can I replace a tutor if my child is not satisfied?
faq.a6: Yes. If a tutor is not the right fit after the initial sessions, our support team will help you find a suitable replacement immediately.
